questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the hemisphere be \(r\) cm. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Given that \[3\pi r^2=432\pi,\] we have \[r^2=144,\] so \[ r=12. \] Therefore, the volume of the hemisphere is \[\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)\] \[=\frac23\pi(12)^3\] \[=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Let the height of cone \(X\) be \(h\) cm. Since cone \(Y\) and cone \(X\) are similar, the height of cone \(Y\) is \[\frac{10}{14}h=\frac57h.\] Thus the volume of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right).\] Since \(Z\) is recast into the hemisphere, \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right)=1152\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{872}{21}h=1152,\] so \[h=\frac{3024}{109}.\] The height of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac27h=\frac{6048}{763}.\] The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{\left(\frac{6048}{763}\right)^2+(14-10)^2}\] \[\approx 8.878686548.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(14^2)+\pi(10^2)+\pi(14+10)(8.878686548).\] Therefore, \[\text{total surface area of }Z\approx 1599.35\text{ cm}^2.\] But \[432\pi\approx 1357.17\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[1357.17<1599.35,\] the total surface area of the hemisphere does not exceed the total surface area of \(Z\). (5 marks)

The heights of the smaller cone and the larger cone are 15 cm and 60 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the smaller cone in terms of \(\pi\). (b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the larger cone is at least \(2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Volume of the cylinder \[=\pi\left(5^{2}\right)(65) \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathbf{1 M}\] \[=1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Height of the smaller cone : height of the larger cone \[=15 \mathrm{~cm}: 60 \mathrm{~cm}\] \[ =1: 4 \] Volume of the smaller cone \[=\frac{1^{3}}{1^{3}+4^{3}} \times 1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[=25 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the larger cone. \[ \frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2}(60)=1625 \pi-25 \pi \\ r=\sqrt{80}\] Total surface area of the larger cone \( =\left[\pi(\sqrt{80})^{2}+\pi(\sqrt{80}) \sqrt{(\sqrt{80})^{2}+60^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \mathbf{1} \mathbf{M} \text { for } \pi r l+\mathbf{1} \mathbf{A} \\ =(80+80 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ \approx 1955.912856 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. In a workshop, \(2\) identical solid metal right circular cylinders of base radius \(R\) cm are melted and recast into \(27\) smaller identical solid right circular cylinders of base radius \(r\) cm and height \(10\) cm. It is given that the base area of a larger circular cylinder is \(9\) times that of a smaller one.

(a) Find

(i) \(r:R\),
(ii) the height of a larger circular cylinder.

(b) A craftsman claims that a smaller circular cylinder and a larger circular cylinder are similar. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
13. 某工作坊將 \(2\) 個底半徑 \(R\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成 \(27\) 個底半徑 \(r\) cm、高 \(10\) cm 的較小相同實心直立圓柱。已知較大圓柱的底面積為較小圓柱的 \(9\) 倍。

(a) 求

(i) \(r:R\)；
(ii) 較大圓柱的高。

questions.solution: (a)(i) \(\frac{\pi r^2}{\pi R^2}=\frac19.\) Thus \(\frac{r}{R}=\frac13,\) so \(r:R=1:3.\) (a)(ii) Let the height of a larger cylinder be \(h\) cm. By conservation of volume, \(2\pi R^2h=27(\pi r^2)(10).\) Thus \(h=\frac{270}{2}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^2 =135\left(\frac13\right)^2=15.\) (b) The radius ratio smaller:larger is \(1:3\), but the height ratio smaller:larger is \[10:15=2:3.\] The ratios are not equal, so the cylinders are not similar. A craftsman finds that the volume of \(Y\) is \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(a) Find the base radius of \(Y\).

(b) Are \(Y\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
14. 實心直立圓柱 \(X\) 的底半徑與實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 的底半徑相等。\(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。實心直立圓錐 \(Z\) 的體積等於 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積之和，\(Z\) 的底半徑等於 \(X\) 的底直徑。某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的體積為 \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的底半徑。

(b) \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

(c) 該工匠聲稱 \(X\) 的曲面面積與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積之和大於 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: (a) Let the common base radius of \(X\) and \(Y\) be \(r\). \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=800\pi\] so \[8r^2=800,\qquad r=10.\] (b) The base radius of \(Z\) is \(20\). The volume of \(X\) is \[\pi(10)^2(20)=2000\pi.\] Thus the volume of \(Z\) is \(2800\pi\). Since the radius ratio \(Y:Z=10:20=1:2\) but the volume ratio \(800\pi:2800\pi=2:7\ne 1:8\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not similar. (c) The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[2\pi(10)(20)=400\pi.\] The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26\), so the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi(10)(26)=260\pi.\] For \(Z\), \[\frac13\pi(20)^2h=2800\pi\] so \(h=21\), and its slant height is \(\sqrt{20^2+21^2}=29\). Hence the curved surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20)(29)=580\pi.\] Since \[400\pi+260\pi=660\pi>580\pi,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(10\text{ cm}\); (b) no; (c) agree.

questions.stemZh:

(a) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立錐體的底面為正方形，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(Z\) 及一個錐體。\(Z\) 的高及總表面積分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(960\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

Final answers: (a) \(18944\text{ cm}^3\); (b) not similar.

questions.stem:

The circular cone is divided into a frustum \(P\), a frustum \(Q\) and a circular cone \(R\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and the height of \(P\) is \(12\) cm.

(a) Find the volume of \(P\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a circular cone \(T\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is \(16\) cm. (a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 的總表面積之和。\(P\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: (a) The radius of the upper circular face of \(P\) is \[20\cdot\frac{48-12}{48}=15.\] Hence \[V_P =\frac13\pi(20)^2(48)-\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)\\ =\boxed{3700\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{20^2+48^2}=52.\] The slant height of \(P\) is \[52\cdot\frac{12}{48}=13.\] Thus the total surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi.\] Since \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and their linear ratio is \(20:15=4:3\), \[\text{TSA of }Q=1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Therefore \[\text{TSA of }S=1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }P}=\frac{1687.5}{1080}=\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }P}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2=\frac{16}{9}.\] Since these are not equal, \(P\) and \(S\) are not similar.

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: (a) The height of cone \(Q\) is \(40-16=24\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r_Q}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \(r_Q=45\) cm. The slant heights of the original cone and \(Q\) are \(85\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. Hence the curved surface area of \(P\) is \(\pi(75)(85)-\pi(45)(51)=4080\pi.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(P\) is \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=\boxed{11730\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)=58800\pi.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) were similar, then \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}.\] However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8.\] Since \(8\ne\frac{4096}{343}\), \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

Since the height ratio is \(1:3:4\), the total number of parts is \[1+3+4=8.\] The heights of the upper part, middle part and lower part are \[15\text{ cm}, 45\text{ cm}, 60\text{ cm}\] respectively. (a) The radius at height 15 cm from the vertex is \[64\left(\frac{15}{120}\right)=8\text{ cm}.\] The radius at height \(15+45=60\) cm from the vertex is \[64\left(\frac{60}{120}\right)=32\text{ cm}.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle frustum is \[\frac13\pi(45)(32^2+32\cdot 8+8^2)\] \[=15\pi(1024+256+64) =20160\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of the middle frustum is \[\sqrt{45^2+(32-8)^2} =\sqrt{2025+576} =51\text{ cm}.\] The total surface area of the middle frustum is \[\pi(32+8)(51)+\pi(32)^2+\pi(8)^2\] \[=2040\pi+1024\pi+64\pi =3128\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] If the middle part and frustum \(X\) are similar, the ratio of their surface areas should be the square of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\left(\frac{45}{10}\right)^2=\frac{81}{4},\] while \[\frac{3128\pi}{400\pi}=\frac{391}{50}.\] Since \[\frac{81}{4}\ne \frac{391}{50},\] the middle part of the cone and frustum \(X\) are not similar. (a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution:
(a) The small cone has radius \(75(24/40)=45\) cm. The original and small slant heights are 85 and 51 cm, so the frustum slant height is 34 cm. Its curved area is \(\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Including both circular faces, the total is \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
(b) P has height 16 cm and volume \(\pi[(75)^2(40)-(45)^2(24)]/3=58800\pi\text{ cm}^3\). The volume ratio P:R is 8:1, so similarity would require a height ratio 2:1. The actual height ratio is 16:7. They are not similar.

(b) \(X\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones \(Y\) and \(Z\). The ratio of the base area of \(Y\) to the base area of \(Z\) is \(16:25\).

(i) Find the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 及 \(Z\)。\(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的底面積比為 \(16:25\)。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 量得 \(Z\) 的總表面積為 \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the base radius of \(X\). Since the curved surface area is \(\pi r l\), \[\pi r(85)=3060\pi.\] Thus \[ r=36. \] The height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{85^2-36^2}=77.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(77)=33264\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Since the base area ratio of \(Y\) to \(Z\) is \(16:25\), their linear ratio is \(4:5\). Hence \(\frac{\text{volume of }Y}{\text{volume of }Z}=\left(\frac45\right)^3=\frac{64}{125}.\) Let the volume of \(Z\) be \(V\). Then the volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac{64}{125}V\), so \(V+\frac{64}{125}V=33264\pi.\) Thus \(\frac{189}{125}V=33264\pi,\) and \(V=22000\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(Z\) is \(22000\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b)(ii) If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, then \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\left(\frac{\text{total surface area of }X}{\text{total surface area of }Z}\right)^{3/2}.\) The total surface area of \(X\) is \(3060\pi+\pi(36)^2=4356\pi.\) Now \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\frac{33264}{22000}=\frac{189}{125},\) but \(\left(\frac{4356\pi}{3025\pi}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac{36}{25}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac65\right)^3 =\frac{216}{125}.\) These are not equal. Therefore, \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar.

Therefore they are not similar.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) P 比相似的 Q 高，所以 P 是下方的截頭錐。其上底半徑為 \(20(36/48)=15\) cm。因此 \(V_P=\pi[(20)^2(48)-(15)^2(36)]/3=3700\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b) 原圓錐斜高為 52 cm，P 斜高為 13 cm。P 總表面積為 \(\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。Q:P 長度比為 3:4，故面積比為 9:16，\(A_S/A_P=25/16\)。若 S 與 P 相似，則高度比應為 5:4，但實際高度比為 16:12 = 4:3，所以不相似。

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a frustum \(P\) and a right circular cone \(Q\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(P\) is 16 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(75\) cm 及 \(40\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的高為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14a. Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Q\). Height of \(Q\) \(=(40-16) \mathrm{cm}\) \(=24 \mathrm{~cm}\) \(\frac{\text { Base radius of } Q}{\text { Base radius of the original circular cone }}=\frac{\text { height of } Q}{\text { height of the original circular cone }}\) \( \frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40} \\ r=45\) Curved surface area of \(P\) \(=\left[\pi(75) \sqrt{40^{2}+75^{2}}-\pi(45) \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=4080 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Total surface area of \(P\) \(=\left[4080 \pi+\pi(45)^{2}+\pi(75)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=11730 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 14b. Volume of \(P\) \( =\left[\frac{1}{3} \pi(75)^{2}(40)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(45)^{2}(24)\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3} \\ =58800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(\left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^{3}=\frac{4096}{343}\) \(\frac{\text { Volume of } P}{\text { Volume of } R}=\frac{58800 \pi}{7350 \pi}=8\) \(\because \left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3} \neq \frac{\text { volume of } P}{\text { volume of } R}\) \(\therefore P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

questions.stem:
9. In Figure 2, the volume of the solid right prism \(ABCDEFGH\) is \(1020\text{ cm}^3\). The base \(ABCD\) of the prism is a trapezium, where \(AD\) is parallel to \(BC\). It is given that \(\angle BAD=90^\circ\), \(AB=12\) cm, \(BC=6\) cm and \(DE=10\) cm.
Find

(a) the length of \(AD\),

(b) the total surface area of the prism \(ABCDEFGH\).
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 圖 2 中，實心直立棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的體積為 \(1020\text{ cm}^3\)。棱柱的底面 \(ABCD\) 為梯形，其中 \(AD\parallel BC\)。已知 \(\angle BAD=90^\circ\)、\(AB=12\) cm、\(BC=6\) cm 及 \(DE=10\) cm。
求

(a) \(AD\) 的長度；

(b) 棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的總表面積。
（5 分）
questions.solution: (a) A right prism has volume equal to base area times its length. Thus the trapezoidal base area is \(1020/10=102\text{ cm}^2\). Its parallel sides are \(BC\) and \(AD\), separated by \(AB=12\) cm. \[\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.\] (b) The horizontal and vertical components of \(CD\) are \(11-6=5\) cm and \(12\) cm. Hence \[CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.\] The total surface area comprises two trapezoidal ends and four rectangular sides: \[S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.\] Check: \(102\times10=1020\text{ cm}^3\), as given.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）直立棱柱體積 = 底面積 × 長度。梯形底面積 = 1020/10 = 102 cm²。平行邊為 BC 及 AD，距離 AB = 12 cm：
\[
\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）CD 的水平及垂直分量分別為 11−6 = 5 cm 及 12 cm：
\[
CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.
\]
總表面積包括兩個梯形端面及四個長方形側面：
\[
S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.
\]

questions.stem:
12. Figure 3(a) shows a solid metal right circular cone of base radius \(48\) cm and height \(96\) cm.

(a) Find the volume of the circular cone in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A hemispherical vessel of radius \(60\) cm is held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessel is fully filled with milk.

(i) Find the volume of the milk in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) The circular cone is now held vertically in the vessel as shown in Figure 3(b). A craftsman claims that the volume of the milk remaining in the vessel is greater than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 圖 3(a) 顯示一個底半徑為 \(48\) cm、高為 \(96\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓錐。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示該圓錐的體積。

(b) 一個半徑為 \(60\) cm 的半球形容器垂直放置在水平面上，容器完全注滿牛奶。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示容器中牛奶的體積。
(ii) 現將該圓錐垂直放入容器中，如圖 3(b) 所示。某工匠聲稱容器中餘下的牛奶體積大於 \(0.3\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.solution: (a) The cone volume is \[V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The hemisphere initially contains \(V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The cone's base touches the hemispherical wall. In an axial section, the distance from the rim plane to the cone's base is \[d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.\] The part above the rim is a smaller cone of height \(96-36=60\) cm, similar to the whole cone. Volumes scale as the cube of corresponding heights. Therefore the submerged frustum displaces \[V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The milk remaining is \[V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3=0.088272\pi\text{ m}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.\] Since this is less than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\), the claim is incorrect.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）圓錐體積：
\[
V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（i）半球初始盛奶：
\[
V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（ii）圓錐底面接觸半球壁。軸向切面中，邊緣平面至圓錐底面距離：
\[
d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.
\]
邊緣以上部分為高 96−36 = 60 cm 的小圓錐，與整錐相似。體積按高度立方縮放。浸水截頭錐排水量：
\[
V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
剩餘牛奶：
\[
V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.
\]
少於 0.3 m³，聲稱不正確。

questions.stem:
11.

(a) Figure 2(a) shows a container of height \(8\) cm which is in the shape of a frustum. The container is made by cutting off a right circular cone with a base circumference of \(24\pi\) cm from a hollow circular cone with a base circumference of \(36\pi\) cm. The container is fully filled with water. Find the volume of the water in the container in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A solid sphere is placed inside the container as shown in Figure 2(b). It is known that the radius of the sphere equals to the height of the container.

(i) Find the volume of the sphere.
(ii) Abby claims that the ratio of the volume of the water remaining in the container to the volume of the water which flowed out is greater than \(2:1\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11.

(a) 圖 2(a) 顯示一個高 \(8\) cm 的截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底圓周 \(24\pi\) cm 的直立圓錐造成，而該圓錐取自一個底圓周 \(36\pi\) cm 的空心圓錐。容器完全注滿水。以 \(\pi\) 求容器中水的體積。

(b) 如圖 2(b)，將一個實心球放入容器內。已知球的半徑等於容器的高度。

(i) 求球的體積。
(ii) Abby 聲稱容器中餘下的水體積與溢出的水體積之比大於 \(2:1\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Let the upper and lower radii of the frustum be \(r_1\) and \(r_2\) respectively. Since the circumferences are \(24\pi\) cm and \(36\pi\) cm, \[2\pi r_1=24\pi,\qquad 2\pi r_2=36\pi.\] Thus \[r_1=12,\qquad r_2=18.\] Let \(h\) be the height of the original cone. By similarity, \[\frac{h-8}{h}=\frac{12}{18}.\] Hence \[ h=24. \] The volume of water in the container is the volume of the frustum: \[V =\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)-\frac13\pi(12)^2(16)\\ =\boxed{1824\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b)(i) The radius of the sphere is \(8\) cm. Hence its volume is \(\frac43\pi(8)^3=\boxed{\frac{2048\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3}.\) (ii) From the figure, the volume of water flowed out is half of the volume of the sphere: \[\frac12\left(\frac{2048\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{1024\pi}{3}.\] The volume of water remaining is \[1824\pi-\frac{1024\pi}{3}=\frac{4448\pi}{3}.\] Therefore, the ratio of the volume of water remaining to the volume of water flowed out is \[\frac{4448\pi}{3}:\frac{1024\pi}{3}=139:32.\] Since \(139:32>2:1\), Abby's claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設截頭錐上下半徑 r₁、r₂。2πr₁ = 24π，2πr₂ = 36π，故 r₁ = 12、r₂ = 18。設原錐高 h：
\[
\frac{h-8}{h}=\frac{12}{18},\quad h=24.
\]
水體積：
\[
V=\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)-\frac13\pi(12)^2(16)=1824\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（i）球半徑 8，體積 = 2048π/3 cm³。
（b）（ii）流出水 = 球體積一半 = 1024π/3。剩餘 = 1824π − 1024π/3 = 4448π/3。比 = 139:32 > 2:1，Abby 正確。

questions.stem:
10. The height and the base radius of a solid right circular cone are 144 cm and 60 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The heights of Part I, Part II and Part III are 36 cm, 48 cm and 60 cm respectively as shown in the figure.
Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of Part I of the circular cone; (3 marks)

(b) the curved surface area of Part II of the circular cone. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
10. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(144\) cm 及 \(60\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，第 I、II、III 部分的高分別為 \(36\) cm、\(48\) cm 及 \(60\) cm，如圖所示。
以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 圓錐第 I 部分的體積；（3 分）

(b) 圓錐第 II 部分的曲面面積。（3 分）
questions.solution: 10. The radius of a cross-section of the cone is proportional to its distance from the vertex. The total height is \(144\) cm and the base radius is \(60\) cm, so the radius at height \(h\) from the vertex is \[\frac{60}{144}h=\frac{5}{12}h.\] (a) Part I is the frustum between heights \(108\) cm and \(144\) cm from the vertex. The two radii are \[\frac{5}{12}(108)=45\] and \[\frac{5}{12}(144)=60.\] The height of Part I is \(36\) cm. Therefore, its volume is \[\frac13\pi(36)(60^2+60\cdot45+45^2)\] \[=12\pi(3600+2700+2025)\] \[=99900\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Part II is the frustum between heights \(60\) cm and \(108\) cm from the vertex. The two radii are \[\frac{5}{12}(60)=25\] and \[\frac{5}{12}(108)=45.\] The vertical height of Part II is \(48\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{48^2+(45-25)^2}=52.\] Therefore, the curved surface area of Part II is \[\pi(45+25)(52)=3640\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (3 marks)

questions.stem:
14. Figure 3(a) shows the front view of a conical transparent decoration with some liquid inside. The base is sealed so that no liquid can come out. The radius and height of the decoration are 3 cm and 7 cm respectively. The decoration is now placed on the horizontal ground with depth of liquid equals 2 cm .

(a) (i) Express the volume of the liquid inside the decoration in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Express the wet curved surface area in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The decoration hung down from the ceiling now so that it is inverted. Ada claims that the wet curved surface area will increase by more than \(50 \%\) after it is inverted. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 圖 3(a) 顯示一個錐形透明裝飾品的正視圖，內有一些液體。底部密封，液體不能流出。裝飾品的半徑及高分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(7\) cm。現將裝飾品放在水平地面上，液體深度為 \(2\) cm。

(a) 

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求裝飾品中液體的體積。
(ii) 以 \(\pi\) 求濕曲面面積。

(b) 現將裝飾品從天花板垂下，倒置過來。Ada 聲稱倒置後濕曲面面積增加超過 \(50\%\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a)(i) Liquid volume \(=\frac13\pi(3)^2(7)[1-(5/7)^3]=654\pi/49\text{ cm}^3\). (ii) Wet curved area \(A=3\pi\sqrt{58}[1-(5/7)^2]=72\pi\sqrt{58}/49\text{ cm}^2\). (b) After inversion the liquid occupies a similar cone with volume fraction \(218/343\). Wet curved area \(B=3\pi\sqrt{58}(218/343)^{2/3}\). The increase \((B/A-1)100\%\approx50.9\%\), so Ada is correct.

questions.stem:
12. Figure (a) shows the sector \(O A B C\). By joining \(O A\) and \(O C\) together, \(O A B C\) is folded to form a right circular cone as shown in figure (b). Given that the radius of the sector is 32 cm .
The reflex angle AOC is \(216^\circ\). (a) Find the height of the cone. (b) A hemispherical vessel of radius 24 cm is full of water. An identical cone rests vertically in the vessel as shown in (c). Dick Hui claims that over 80% of its curved surface is immersed. Is he correct? Explain.
questions.stemZh: 圖 (a) 是半徑 32 cm 的扇形 OABC，優角 AOC 為 216°。將 OA 與 OC 接合，摺成圖 (b) 的直立圓錐。（a）求圓錐的高。（b）半徑 24 cm 的半球容器注滿水。將一個相同圓錐垂直放入容器，如圖 (c)。Dick Hui 聲稱超過 80% 的圓錐曲面浸入水中。他是否正確？解釋答案。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let the base radius of the cone be \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) \[2 \pi(32) \times \frac{216}{360}=2 \pi r\] \[ r=19.2 \] Let the height of the cone be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) \[h=\sqrt{32^{2}-(19.2)^{2}}=25.6\] (b) Height of the frustum that is immersed in water \(=\sqrt{24^{2}-19.2^{2}}=14.4 \mathrm{~cm}\). Height of the smaller cone that is not immersed in water \(=11.2 \mathrm{~cm}\) Consider the ratio of curved surface area of the smaller cone \(A_{1}\) and that of the larger cone \(A_{2}\) \(\frac{A_{1}}{A_{2}}=\left(\frac{11.2}{25.6}\right)^{2}\) \(\frac{A_{1}}{A_{2}}=\frac{49}{256}\) \% immersed \(=\frac{256-49}{256} \times 100 \%\) \(=80.8 \%>80 \%\) Therefore, his claim is correct.

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal sphere of radius 36 cm is melted and recast into a solid right circular cone of height 81 cm .

(a) Find the base radius of the right circular cone.

(b) A hemispherical bowl of radius 73 cm contains some water originally. The solid right circular cone in (a) is then slowly put into the bowl until it sits vertically in the bowl as shown in the figure below. After placing the cone in the bowl, the water level rises and the bowl is just full of water.
Someone claims that the total wet surface area of the circular cone and the bowl is less than \(5.3 \mathrm{~m}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個半徑 \(36\) cm 的實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個高 \(81\) cm 的實心直立圓錐。

(a) 求該直立圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 一個半徑 \(73\) cm 的半球形碗盛有一些水。然後將 

(a) 的直立圓錐慢慢放入碗中，直至垂直放置在碗內，如下圖所示。放入圓錐後水位上升，碗剛好注滿水。
某人聲稱圓錐與碗的總濕表面積少於 \(5.3\text{ m}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Volume of the metal sphere \[ =\frac{4}{3} \pi(36)^{3} \\ =62208 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the right circular cone. \[ \frac{1}{3} \pi(81) r^{2}=62208 \pi \\ r=48\] ∴ The base radius of the right circular cone is 48 cm . (b) Refer to the following figure. Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the length of \(M N\). \(73^{2} =h^{2}+48^{2} \text { (Pyth. theorem) } \\ h =\sqrt{73^{2}-48^{2}} \\ =55 \\ V N =V M-M N \\ =(81-55) \mathrm{cm} \\ =26 \mathrm{~cm}\) Total surface area of the cone and the hemispherical bowl \( =2 \pi(73)^{2}+\pi(48)^{2}+\pi(48) \sqrt{81^{2}+48^{2}}\left[1-\left(\frac{26}{81}\right)^{2}\right] \\ =12962 \pi+\pi(48) \sqrt{8865}\left(\frac{5885}{6561}\right) \\ =53500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}(3 \text { s.f. }) \\ >5.3 \mathrm{~m}^{2}\) \(\therefore \) The claim is disagreed.
questions.solutionZh: （a）由體積守恆，\(\frac13\pi r^2(81)=\frac43\pi(36)^3\)，得 \(r=48\text{ cm}\)。（b）碗邊緣至圓錐底的深度 \(=\sqrt{73^2-48^2}=55\text{ cm}\)，未浸水小錐高為 \(81-55=26\text{ cm}\)。斜高 \(l=\sqrt{81^2+48^2}=\sqrt{8865}\)。總濕表面包括碗的內曲面、圓錐底面及浸水曲面：\[2\pi(73)^2+\pi(48)^2+\pi(48)\sqrt{8865}\left[1-\left(\frac{26}{81}\right)^2\right]\approx53500\text{ cm}^2=5.35\text{ m}^2.\]大於 5.3 m²，因此不同意。
questions.hint: Identify the required region or immersed portion before applying area or volume formulas.
questions.hintZh: 先辨認所求區域或浸入部分，再使用面積或體積公式。
questions.sourceZh: Mock 2425 P1 Q14

questions.stem:
The bar chart below shows the distribution of the most favourite fruits of the students in a group. It is given that each student has only one most favourite fruit.

If a student is randomly selected from the group, the probability that the most favourite fruit is apple is \(\frac3{20}\).

(a) Find k.

(b) (i)

Suppose that the above distribution is represented by a pie chart. Find the angle of the sector representing that the most favourite fruit is orange.

(ii) Some new students now join the group and the most favourite fruit of each of these students is orange. Will the angle of the sector representing that the most favourite fruit is orange be doubled? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列棒形圖顯示一組學生最喜愛的水果分布。每名學生只有一種最喜愛的水果。

若隨機選取一名學生，其最喜愛的水果為蘋果的概率為 \(\frac3{20}\)。

(a) 求 k。

(b) (i)

若以圓形圖表示上述分布，求代表最喜愛水果為橙的扇形角度。

(ii) 一些新學生加入，每人最喜愛的水果均為橙。代表橙的扇形角度會否增加一倍？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) k=8. (b)(i) 45°; (ii) No. Originally there are 40 students, of whom 5 prefer orange. Doubling the sector requires (5+n)/(40+n)=1/4, hence n=20/3, which is not an integer number of students.
questions.solutionZh: (a) k=8；(b)(i) 45°；(ii) 不會。原有 40 人，其中 5 人喜愛橙。若加入 n 人後角度加倍，須有 (5+n)/(40+n)=1/4，解得 n=20/3，並非整數人數。
questions.sourceZh: HKDSE Practice Paper · P1 Q13

questions.stem:
The histogram in the figure shows the distribution of scores of a class of 40 students in a test.

The 68≤x<76 bar is restored to frequency 11, as in the official original paper.

(a) Complete the table.

(b) Estimate the mean and standard deviation of the distribution.

(c) Susan scores 76 in this test. Find her standard score.

(d) Another test is given to the same class of students. It is found that the mean and standard deviation of the scores in this second test are 58 and 10 respectively. Relative to her classmates, if Susan performs equally well in these two tests, estimate her score in the second test.
questions.stemZh:
圖中直方圖顯示一班 40 名學生的測驗成績分布。

68≤x<76 的棒形已按公開試原卷還原為頻數 11。

(a) 完成下表。

(b) 估計此分布的平均數及標準差。

(c) Susan 在此次測驗得 76 分。求她的標準分。

(d) 該班進行另一次測驗，平均數及標準差分別為 58 及 10。若相對於同學，Susan 在兩次測驗表現相同，估計她第二次的分數。
questions.solution: (a) Class marks: 48,56,64,72,80; frequencies: 3,9,15,11,2; missing classes: 60≤x<68, 76≤x<84. (b) Mean ≈64; σ ≈8. (c) ≈1.5. (d) ≈73 marks.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 組中點依次為 48、56、64、72、80；頻數依次為 3、9、15、11、2。欠缺的組別為 60≤x<68 及 76≤x<84。(b) 平均數約 64，標準差約 8；(c) 標準分約 1.5；(d) 第二次測驗的分數約 73 分。

questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the ages of the players of a football team:

(a) Find the mean, the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team.

(b) As the two oldest players leave the team, three new players join the football team. After the three players join the football team, the manager of the team finds that the mean of the ages of the players of the football team is the same as the mean found in (a).

(i) Find the mean age of the three new players.

(ii) Furthermore, the manager finds that the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team are the same as the median and the range found in (a) respectively. Write down two sets of possible ages of the three new players.
questions.stemZh:
莖葉圖顯示一支足球隊球員的年齡：

(a) 求球員年齡的平均數、中位數及分佈域。

(b) 兩名最年長球員離隊，另有三名新球員加入。領隊發現新隊伍球員年齡的平均數與 (a) 所求相同。

(i) 求三名新球員年齡的平均數。

(ii) 領隊亦發現中位數及分佈域分別與 (a) 所求相同。寫出三名新球員年齡的兩組可能數值。
questions.solutionZh: (a) 平均年齡 25 歲，中位數 26 歲，分佈域 13 歲；(b)(i) 新球員的平均年齡為 29 歲；(ii) 例如 (25,31,31) 或 (26,30,31) 歲。
questions.sourceZh: HKCEE 2010 · P1 Q11

(a) Find the mean, the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team.

(b) As the two oldest players leave the team, three new players join the football team. After the three players join the football team, the manager of the team finds that the mean of the ages of the players of the football team is the same as the mean found in (a).
(i) Find the mean age of the three new players.

(ii) Furthermore, the manager finds that the median and the range of the ages of the players of the football team are the same as the median and the range found in (a) respectively. Write down two sets of possible ages of the three new players.

zh-Hant.text: 莖葉圖顯示一支足球隊球員的年齡：
(a) 求球員年齡的平均數、中位數及分佈域。
(b) 兩名最年長球員離隊，另有三名新球員加入。領隊發現新隊伍球員年齡的平均數與 (a) 所求相同。
(i) 求三名新球員年齡的平均數。
(ii) 領隊亦發現中位數及分佈域分別與 (a) 所求相同。寫出三名新球員年齡的兩組可能數值。

questions.stem:
The revision times (in minutes) of 19 students are represented by the stem-and-leaf diagram in the figure. It is known that the mean revision time is (40+b) minutes.

(a) Find a and b.

(b) Find the standard deviation of the revision times for the students.

(c) The revision times of 2 more students are added. If both the range and the mean do not change after the inclusion of the 2 data, find the range of possible values of the standard deviation of the revision times for the 21 students.
questions.stemZh:
莖葉圖顯示 19 名學生的溫習時間（分鐘）。已知平均溫習時間為 (40+b) 分鐘。

(a) 求 a 及 b。

(b) 求學生溫習時間的標準差。

(c) 加入另外兩名學生的溫習時間，分佈域及平均數均不變。求這 21 名學生溫習時間的標準差的可能數值範圍。
questions.solution: (a) a=1, b=3. (b) σ ≈12.19 min. (c) 11.596≤σ≤12.728 min (rounded endpoints). The two added times sum to 86; the minimum is attained at (43,43) and the maximum at (26,60).
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=1，b=3；(b) 標準差約 12.19 分鐘；(c) 標準差介乎約 11.596 至 12.728 分鐘，包含兩端。新增兩項時間之和為 86，最小值在 (43,43) 取得，最大值在 (26,60) 取得。
questions.sourceZh: HKALE MS 2011 · Q6

(c) The revision times of 2 more students are added. If both the range and the mean do not change after the inclusion of the 2 data, find the range of possible values of the standard deviation of the revision times for the 21 students.

questions.stem:
The data below show the percentages of customers who bought newspaper A from a magazine stall in city H for five days randomly selected in a certain week:

62%　63%　55%　62%　58%

(a) Find the median and the mean of the above data.

(b) Let a% and b% be the percentages of customers who bought newspaper A from the stall for the other two days in that week. The two percentages are combined with the above data to form a set of seven data.

(i) Write down the least possible value of the median of the combined set of seven data.

(ii) It is known that the median and the mean of the combined set of seven data are the same as that found in (a). Write down one pair of possible values of a and b.

(c) The stall-keeper claims that since the median and the mean found in (a) exceed 50%, newspaper A has the largest market share among the newspapers in city H. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
以下為某星期隨機選取五天中，在 H 市一報攤購買報紙 A 的顧客百分率：

62%　63%　55%　62%　58%

(a) 求上述數據的中位數及平均數。

(b) 設該星期其餘兩天的百分率為 a% 及 b%。把這兩項與上述數據合併成七項數據。

(i) 寫出合併數據中位數的最小可能值。

(ii) 已知合併後中位數及平均數分別與 (a) 所求相同。寫出 a 及 b 的一組可能值。

(c) 報攤店主聲稱，由於 (a) 的中位數及平均數超過 50%，報紙 A 在 H 市的報紙市場佔有率最高。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 62%; mean 60%. (b)(i) 58%; (ii) e.g. a=57, b=63. (c) Disagree: five days at a single stall do not establish city-wide newspaper market shares.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 62%，平均數 60%；(b)(i) 最小中位數為 58%；(ii) 例如 a=57，b=63；(c) 不同意。單一報攤五天的樣本，不能代表全市報章的市場佔有率。
questions.sourceZh: HKDSE Sample Paper · P1 Q14

questions.stem:
6 boys and 5 girls attempted a classwork in a lesson. The time taken (in minutes) for the boys to finish the classwork are recorded as follows:

2　4　6　8　8　8

It is known that the mean, mode and median of the time taken by the girls are all 1 minute more than those of the boys.

questions.stemZh:

questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of weekly wages (in dollars) of 30 staff members of a company.

It is known that the difference between the inter-quartile range and the range of the distribution is $3500.

(a) Find the median and the mean of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.

(b) Write down the greatest possible standard deviation of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.

(c) The manager proposed a pay rise for all the staff members in the company such that the median of their weekly wages will increase by 25% and the inter-quartile range will remain unchanged. Describe how the manager should raise the wages of each of the 30 staff members.
questions.stemZh:
下列莖葉圖顯示某公司 30 名員工的每週薪金（元）分布。

已知此分布的四分位距與分佈域之差為 3500 元。

(a) 求該 30 名員工每週薪金的中位數及平均數。

(b) 寫出該 30 名員工每週薪金標準差的最大可能值。

(c) 經理建議全體員工加薪，使每週薪金的中位數增加 25%，而四分位距保持不變。描述經理應如何為每名員工加薪。
questions.solution: (a) Median $9350; mean $9450. (b) σ ≈$1605.8. (c) Add $2337.50 to every weekly wage.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 週薪中位數為 $9350，平均數為 $9450；(b) 最大標準差約 $1605.8；(c) 每人的週薪增加 $2337.50，中位數便增加 25%，四分位距不變。

en.text: The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of weekly wages (in dollars) of 30 staff members of a company.
It is known that the difference between the inter-quartile range and the range of the distribution is $3500.
(a) Find the median and the mean of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.
(b) Write down the greatest possible standard deviation of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.

(c) The manager proposed a pay rise for all the staff members in the company such that the median of their weekly wages will increase by 25% and the inter-quartile range will remain unchanged. Describe how the manager should raise the wages of each of the 30 staff members.

zh-Hant.text: 下列莖葉圖顯示某公司 30 名員工的每週薪金（元）分布。
已知此分布的四分位距與分佈域之差為 3500 元。
(a) 求該 30 名員工每週薪金的中位數及平均數。
(b) 寫出該 30 名員工每週薪金標準差的最大可能值。
(c) 經理建議全體員工加薪，使每週薪金的中位數增加 25%，而四分位距保持不變。描述經理應如何為每名員工加薪。

questions.stem:
A test was carried out to see how quickly a class of students reacted to a visual instruction to press a particular key when they played a computer game. Their reaction times, measured in tenths of a second, are recorded and the statistics for the whole class are summarised below.

(a) Draw two box-and-whisker diagrams comparing the reaction times of boys and girls.

(b) Suppose a boy and a girl are randomly selected from the class. Which one will have a bigger chance of having a reaction time shorter than 1.1 seconds? Explain.

For (b), use the usual boxplot convention. Strict probabilities require more information about repeated reaction times.
questions.stemZh:
一班學生在電腦遊戲中按視覺指示按鍵，測試其反應速度。反應時間以十分之一秒為單位，統計量如下。

(a) 繪畫兩個框線圖，比較男生與女生的反應時間。

(b) 從該班隨機各選一名男生及女生，誰的反應時間少於 1.1 秒的機會較大？解釋。

(b) 按框線圖的一般詮釋作答；若嚴格比較「少於」的概率，尚需重複數值的資料。
questions.solution: (a) Boys: (5,8,11,14,17); girls: (7,9,11,16,21). (b) Same chance under the usual median interpretation; strict probability is not determined by these summaries alone.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 男生的五數概括為 (5,8,11,14,17)，女生為 (7,9,11,16,21)，單位為十分之一秒。依此在同一尺度繪製框線圖。(b) 按一般中位數讀圖慣例，兩者機會相同；但若問嚴格小於 1.1 秒的精確概率，單靠五數概括不足以確定，須知道重複數據。
questions.sourceZh: HKALE MS 1999 · Q3

(b) Suppose a boy and a girl are randomly selected from the class. Which one will have a bigger chance of having a reaction time shorter than 1.1 seconds? Explain.
For (b), use the usual boxplot convention. Strict probabilities require more information about repeated reaction times.

questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the distribution of the numbers of books read by 24 students of a school in the first term.

(a) Find the median and the interquartile range of the numbers of books read.

(b) The librarian of the school ran a reading award scheme in the second term. The following table shows some statistics of the distribution of the numbers of books read by these 24 students in the second term:

(i) Draw two box-and-whisker diagrams of the same scale to compare the numbers of books read by the students in the first term and in the second term.

(ii) The librarian claims that not less than 50% of the students read at least 5 more books in the second term than in the first term. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
莖葉圖顯示某校 24 名學生在第一學期閱讀的書籍數目分布。

(a) 求閱讀書籍數目的中位數及四分位距。

(b) 圖書館主任在第二學期推行閱讀獎勵計劃。下表顯示該 24 名學生在第二學期閱讀書籍數目的部分統計量：

(i) 以相同比例繪畫兩個框線圖，比較兩學期閱讀的書籍數目。

(ii) 圖書館主任聲稱，不少於 50% 學生在第二學期比第一學期至少多讀 5 本書。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 18; IQR 13. (b)(i) Term 1: (3,12,18,25,30); term 2: (8,26,35,41,46), on the same scale. (ii) Agree: at least half read at least 35 books in term 2, while every student read at most 30 in term 1, so each of those students read at least 5 more.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 18，四分位距 13；(b)(i) 第一學期五數概括為 (3,12,18,25,30)，第二學期為 (8,26,35,41,46)，以同一尺度繪圖；(ii) 同意。至少一半學生第二學期讀了不少於 35 本，第一學期全部學生最多讀 30 本，因此這批學生均至少多讀 5 本。
questions.sourceZh: HKALE MS 2006 · Q4

(b) 圖書館主任在第二學期推行閱讀獎勵計劃。下表顯示該 24 名學生在第二學期閱讀書籍數目的部分統計量：

questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of the typing speed (in words per minute) of 20 students in a school before training.

(a) Find the median, the range and the inter-quartile range of the above distribution.

(b) The box-and-whisker diagram below shows the distribution of the typing speed (in words per minute) of the 20 students after the training.

(i) Is the distribution of the typing speed after the training more dispersed than that before the training? Explain your answer.

(ii) The trainer claims that not less than half of these students show improvement in their typing speed after the training. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列莖葉圖顯示某校 20 名學生訓練前的打字速度（字／分鐘）分布。

(a) 求上述分布的中位數、分佈域及四分位距。

(b) 下列框線圖顯示該 20 名學生訓練後的打字速度（字／分鐘）分布。

(i) 訓練後的打字速度分布是否比訓練前更分散？解釋你的答案。

(ii) 導師聲稱不少於一半學生的打字速度在訓練後有所改善。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 26; range 27; IQR 14. (b)(i) No; range 25<27 and IQR 12<14. (ii) Agree: at least half had speeds at most 26 before training, while every speed afterwards is at least 27.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 26，分佈域 27，四分位距 14；(b)(i) 不是。訓練後分佈域為 25、四分位距為 12，均較小；(ii) 同意。訓練前至少一半學生的速度不高於 26，訓練後全部速度至少為 27，故至少一半有進步。

questions.stem:
The student union of a school conducts two surveys to measure the extent of the students’ satisfaction on the services provided by the school library. A score from 0 to 100 is used to measure the extent of satisfaction on the services, with 0 indicating absolute dissatisfaction and 100 indicating absolute satisfaction. The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the distribution of scores rated by 32 students in the first survey.

(a) Find the median, the range and the inter-quartile range of the above distribution.

(b) After six months, the student union conducts the second survey to these 32 students. The box-and-whisker diagram shows the distribution of scores rated by the students in the second survey.

(i) Is the distribution of scores in the second survey less dispersed than that in the first survey? Explain your answer.

(ii) The chairman of the student union claims that at least 25% of the students have a greater extent of satisfaction shown in the second survey than the first survey. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
某校學生會進行兩次調查，以 0 至 100 分衡量學生對圖書館服務的滿意程度，0 分代表完全不滿意，100 分代表完全滿意。莖葉圖顯示 32 名學生在第一次調查的評分分布。

(a) 求上述分布的中位數、分佈域及四分位距。

(b) 六個月後，學生會向同一批學生進行第二次調查。框線圖顯示第二次評分的分布。

(i) 第二次評分分布是否比第一次較不分散？解釋你的答案。

(ii) 學生會主席聲稱，至少 25% 學生在第二次調查中顯示的滿意程度比第一次更高。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 57; range 52; IQR 22. (b)(i) Yes; range 34<52 and IQR 17<22. (ii) Agree: at least 8 first-survey scores were at most 43, while every second-survey score is at least 44.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 57，分佈域 52，四分位距 22；(b)(i) 是。第二次調查的分佈域為 34、四分位距為 17，均較小；(ii) 同意。第一次至少 8 人的評分不高於 43，第二次全部評分至少為 44，故至少 25% 的學生提高了評分。
questions.sourceZh: HKCEE 2011 · P1 Q10

questions.stem:
The box-and-whisker diagram below shows the distribution of the times taken by a large group of students of an athletic club to finish a 100 m race:

The inter-quartile range and the range of the distribution are 3.2 s and 6.8 s respectively.

(a) Find a and b.

(b) The students join a training program. It is found that the longest time taken by the students to finish a 100 m race after the training is 2.9 s less than that before the training. The trainer claims that at least 25% of the students show improvement in the time taken to finish a 100 m race after the training. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列框線圖顯示某田徑會一大組學生完成 100 m 賽跑的時間分布：

此分布的四分位距及分佈域分別為 3.2 秒及 6.8 秒。

(a) 求 a 及 b。

(b) 學生接受訓練後，最長完成時間比訓練前短 2.9 秒。導師聲稱至少 25% 學生的完成時間有所改善。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) a=11.3, b=15.3. (b) Agree: the new maximum is 15.2 s, below the old upper quartile 15.3 s, guaranteeing improvement for at least 25% of students.
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=11.3，b=15.3；(b) 同意。訓練後最長時間為 15.2 秒，小於原上四分位數 15.3 秒，故至少 25% 的學生有進步。

The following frequency distribution table and the cumulative frequency distribution table show the distribution of test marks of 40 students in group A, where the test marks are integers.

(a) Write down the values a, b, c and d.

(b) Write down the estimated mean marks in group A.

(c) In Figure 2, the box-and-whisker diagram shows the distribution of the test marks of another 80 students in group B.

(i) Amy claims that at least 20 students in group B have higher marks than any one student in group A. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

(ii) Ben claims that the inter-quartile range of the marks in group B must be greater than that in group A. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列頻數分布表及累積頻數分布表顯示 A 組 40 名學生的測驗分數分布，其中分數為整數。

(a) 寫出 a、b、c 及 d 的值。

(b) 寫出 A 組平均分的估計值。

(c) 圖 2 的框線圖顯示 B 組另外 80 名學生的測驗分數分布。

(i) Amy 聲稱 B 組至少 20 名學生的分數高於 A 組任何一名學生。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。

(ii) Ben 聲稱 B 組分數的四分位距必定大於 A 組。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) a=7, b=8, c=10, d=30. (b) ≈24.875 marks. (c)(i) Agree: group B has upper quartile 37, above group A’s maximum possible mark 35, so at least 20 group-B students score higher than everyone in A. (ii) Agree: group A has IQR at most 30−16=14, whereas group B has IQR 37−22=15.
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=7，b=8，c=10，d=30；(b) 估計平均分為 24.875；(c)(i) 同意。B 組上四分位數 37 高於 A 組最高可能分數 35，故 B 組至少 20 人高於 A 組全部學生；(ii) 同意。A 組四分位距最多為 30−16=14，B 組則為 37−22=15。

questions.stem:
Tom conducts a survey on the numbers of hours spent on doing homework in a week by secondary students. Questionnaires are sent out and twenty of them are returned. The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the numbers of hours recorded in the twenty questionnaires:

(a) Find the mean and the median of the numbers of hours recorded in the twenty questionnaires.

(b) Tom receives four more questionnaires. He finds that the mean of the numbers of hours recorded in these four questionnaires is 18. It is found that the numbers of hours recorded in two of these four questionnaires are 19 and 20.

(i) Write down the mean of the numbers of hours recorded in the twenty-four questionnaires.

(ii) Is it possible that the median of the numbers of hours recorded in the twenty-four questionnaires is the same as the median found in (a)? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
Tom 調查中學生一星期做家課的時數，收回 20 份問卷。莖葉圖顯示問卷記錄的時數：

(a) 求 20 份問卷所記錄時數的平均數及中位數。

(b) Tom 再收回四份問卷，其時數平均數為 18。其中兩份的時數為 19 及 20。

(i) 寫出全部 24 份問卷時數的平均數。

(ii) 全部 24 份問卷時數的中位數有可能與 (a) 相同嗎？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Mean 18; median 16. (b)(i) 18; (ii) No: the other two new values sum to 33, so at most one is at most 16. The new median is at least 16.5.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 平均數 18 小時，中位數 16 小時；(b)(i) 新平均數仍為 18 小時；(ii) 不可能。另兩份問卷的時數之和為 33，最多只有一項不大於 16；新中位數至少為 16.5 小時。
questions.sourceZh: HKDSE 2012 · P1 Q10

(b) Tom receives four more questionnaires. He finds that the mean of the numbers of hours recorded in these four questionnaires is 18. It is found that the numbers of hours recorded in two of these four questionnaires are 19 and 20.

questions.stemZh:

(ii) 若分佈域減少，求此分布標準差的最大可能值。
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=2，b=1；(b)(i) 眾數不變，仍為 36 歲；(ii) 最大標準差約 7.163 歲。

The table below shows the distribution of the numbers of calculators owned by a class of students.

The mean of the distribution is 2.

(a) Find the median, the inter-quartile range and the variance of the distribution.

(b) Two students now withdraw from the class. It is found that the mean of the distribution remains unchanged. Is there any change in the range of the distribution due to the withdrawal of the two students? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下表顯示一班學生擁有的計算機數目分布。

此分布的平均數為 2。

(b) 兩名學生退學後，平均數不變。分佈域會否因而改變？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Median 2; IQR 2; variance 0.9. (b) No; range remains 3. The departing students must own (1,3) or (2,2) calculators, so both extreme categories remain.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 中位數 2，四分位距 2，方差 0.9；(b) 不變，分佈域仍為 3。退出者的計算機數目只能是 (1,3) 或 (2,2)，不會移除全部最小值或最大值。

The mean and the mode of the distribution are the same and the inter-quartile range is one-third of the range.

(a) Find h and k.

(b) A student is now added to the group.

(i) Is there any change in the median of the distribution due to the additional student? Explain your answer.

(ii) If the range of the distribution is increased by 1, is it possible that the standard deviation of the distribution is less than 12.7? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列莖葉圖顯示一組學生一分鐘內輸入的中文字數分布。

questions.solution: (a) h=7, k=3. (b)(i) Unchanged (38); (ii) No: a one-unit range increase requires a new value of 20 or 70, and both resulting standard deviations exceed 12.7.
questions.solutionZh: (a) h=7，k=3；(b)(i) 中位數不變，仍為 38；(ii) 不可能。分佈域增加 1 時，新數據只能是 20 或 70，兩者所得標準差均大於 12.7。

It is given that the range and the inter-quartile range of the distribution are $4600 and $2250 respectively.

(a) Find a and b.

(b) Two employees resigned and the corresponding salaries are deleted from the stem-and-leaf diagram. Both the median and the mode of the remaining salaries remain unchanged.

(i) Find the two deleted salaries if the mean of the remaining salaries is decreased by $100.

(ii) Someone claims that the decrease of the mean in (b)(i) is at its greatest value. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下列莖葉圖顯示某公司僱員的薪金分布。

已知此分布的分佈域及四分位距分別為 4600 元及 2250 元。

(a) 求 a 及 b。

(b) 兩名僱員辭職，其薪金從莖葉圖刪去。餘下薪金的中位數及眾數均保持不變。

(i) 若餘下薪金的平均數減少 100 元，求刪去的兩個薪金。

(ii) 有人聲稱 (b)(i) 中平均數的減幅已是最大值。你是否同意？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) a=3, b=7. (b)(i) $17800 and $20900; (ii) Disagree: deleting $18600 and $20900 also preserves the median and both modes, but decreases the mean by more than $100.
questions.solutionZh: (a) a=3，b=7；(b)(i) 被刪除的月薪為 $17800 及 $20900；(ii) 不同意。若刪除 $18600 及 $20900，中位數及兩個眾數仍不變，但平均數的減幅大於 $100。

questions.stem:
The table below shows the distribution of the numbers of books read by a group of students in a week.

(a) Find the mean, the mode and the median of the distribution.

(b) n more students join the group and each of them reads 9 books.

(i) Write down the least value of n such that the median of the distribution is increased by 2.

(ii) m more students join the group too and each of them reads 2 books, where \(1\lt m\lt 13\). If the mean of the distribution remains unchanged, find the greatest possible standard deviation.

Clarification: (b)(i) and (b)(ii) are separate cases; in (ii), n is not fixed at the minimum found in (i).

(b) 另有 n 名學生加入該組，每人閱讀 9 本書。

(i) 寫出使此分布的中位數增加 2 的 n 的最小值。

(ii) 再有 m 名學生加入該組，每人閱讀 2 本書，其中 \(1\lt m\lt 13\)。若此分布的平均數保持不變，求標準差的最大可能值。

題意說明：(b)(i) 與 (b)(ii) 分別考慮；(ii) 中的 n 不限於 (i) 所求的最小值。
questions.solution: (a) Mean 3; mode 1; median 2. (b)(i) n=13; (ii) σ ≈2.387.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 平均數 3，眾數 1，中位數 2；(b)(i) n 的最小值為 13；(ii) 最大標準差約 2.387。(i) 與 (ii) 為獨立情況；(ii) 的 n 不固定為 13。

questions.stem:
The following are the marks scored by a class of 35 students in a Mathematics test:

0　0　5　8　11　12　41　42　45　48

50　62　70　73　73　73　77　78　80　80

82　82　82　83　83　85　85　87　90　90

95　95　95　95　98

(a) Find the mean, mode, median and standard deviation of the above marks. (Working need not be shown.)

(b) Explain briefly why the mean may not be a suitable measure of central tendency of the distribution of marks in this Mathematics test.

(c) The mean and standard deviation of the marks scored by the same class of students in an English test are 63 and 15 respectively.

(i) The standard score of a student in the English test was 0.4. Find the mark the student scored in this test.

(ii) Assume that the marks in the English test are normally distributed and the marks scored by Lai Wah in both the Mathematics and English tests are 78.

(1) What percentage of her classmates scored fewer marks than Lai Wah in the Mathematics test?

(2) Relative to her classmates, did Lai Wah perform better in the English test than in the Mathematics test?

(iii) The English teacher later found that a student was given 10 marks fewer in the English test. Find the mean of the marks in the English test after the wrong mark has been corrected.
questions.stemZh:
以下為一班 35 名學生的數學測驗分數：

0　0　5　8　11　12　41　42　45　48

50　62　70　73　73　73　77　78　80　80

82　82　82　83　83　85　85　87　90　90

95　95　95　95　98

(a) 求上述分數的平均數、眾數、中位數及標準差。（毋須列出算式。）

(b) 簡略解釋為何平均數未必適合衡量此數學測驗分數的集中趨勢。

(c) 同班學生的英文測驗平均數及標準差分別為 63 及 15。

(i) 一名學生英文測驗的標準分為 0.4，求其分數。

(ii) 假設英文測驗分數呈正態分布，而麗華在數學及英文測驗均得 78 分。

(1) 她的同班同學中，有多少百分比在數學測驗的分數比她低？

(2) 相對於同班同學，麗華在英文測驗的表現是否比數學測驗更好？

(iii) 英文老師後來發現一名學生被少給了 10 分。求更正後英文測驗的平均數。
questions.solution: (a) Mean 64.4286; mode 95; median 78; σ ≈30.59. (b) Very low scores pull down the mean. (c)(i) 69; (ii)(1) 50%; (2) Yes; (iii) 63.2857… marks.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 平均數約 64.4286，眾數 95，中位數 78，標準差約 30.59；(b) 極低分數拉低平均數，令它未必能代表典型表現；(c)(i) 69 分；(ii)(1) 50%，即 34 名同學中有 17 人低於麗華；(2) 是，英文標準分為 1，相對表現高於數學；(iii) 更正後英文平均分約 63.2857 分。
questions.sourceZh: HKCEE 1997 · P1 Q11

questions.solution: (a) 60 marks. (b) Agree: the median 55 is below the mean 60, so at least half have negative standard scores.

questions.stem:
The table below shows the means and the standard deviations of the scores of a large group of students in a Mathematics examination and a Science examination:

The standard score of David in the Mathematics examination is −0.5.

(a) Find the score of David in the Mathematics examination.

(b) Assume that the scores in each of the above examinations are normally distributed. David gets 49 marks in the Science examination. questions.solution: (a) 60 marks. (b) Correct (−0.3>−0.5).
questions.solutionZh: (a) 數學分數為 60；(b) 聲稱正確。科學標準分為 −0.3，高於數學的 −0.5。

questions.stem:
The mean score of a class of students in a test is 48 marks. The scores of Mary and John in the test are 36 marks and 66 marks respectively. The standard score of Mary in the test is −2.

(a) Find the standard score of John in the test.

(b) A student, David, withdraws from the class and his test score is then deleted. It is given that his test score is 48 marks. Will there be any change in the standard score of John due to the deletion of the test score of David? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
一班學生的測驗平均分為 48 分。Mary 及 John 分別得 36 及 66 分，而 Mary 的標準分為 −2。

(a) 求 John 的標準分。

(b) David 退學，他的 48 分記錄被刪去。John 的標準分會否因而改變？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) 3. (b) Decreases: deleting a score equal to the mean preserves the mean but increases the standard deviation, reducing John’s positive standard score.
questions.solutionZh: (a) John 的標準分為 3；(b) 減少。刪除等於平均數的分數後，平均數不變，但標準差增加，因此 John 的正標準分減少。
questions.sourceZh: HKDSE Practice Paper · P1 Q15

questions.stem:
The standard deviation of the test scores obtained by a class of students in a Mathematics test is 10 marks. All the students fail in the test, so the test score of each student is adjusted such that each score is increased by 20% and then extra 5 marks are added.

(a) Find the standard deviation of the test scores after the score adjustment.

(b) Is there any change in the standard score of each student due to the score adjustment? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
一班學生數學測驗分數的標準差為 10 分。由於全班不合格，每人的分數先增加 20%，再加 5 分。

(a) 求調分後的標準差。

(b) 每名學生的標準分會否因調分而改變？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) 12 marks. (b) Unchanged: the positive affine transformation scales every deviation and the standard deviation by the same factor 1.2.
questions.solutionZh: (a) 新標準差為 12 分；(b) 各人的標準分均不變，因為離均差及標準差按同一正比例變換。
questions.sourceZh: HKDSE 2012 · P1 Q15

questions.stem: In a test, the mean of the distribution of the scores of a class of students is 61 marks. The standard scores of Albert and Mary are −2.6 and 1.4 respectively. Albert gets 22 marks. A student claims that the range of the distribution is at most 59 marks. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh: 某班測驗平均分為 61 分。Albert 及 Mary 的標準分分別為 −2.6 及 1.4，而 Albert 得 22 分。一名學生聲稱此分布的分佈域最多為 59 分。這聲稱是否正確？解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: Incorrect; the range is at least 60 marks.
questions.solutionZh: 聲稱不正確。標準差為 15，Mary 得 82 分，與 Albert 的 22 分相差 60 分，因此分佈域至少為 60 分。

questions.stem:
The table below shows the means and the standard deviations of the scores of a large group of students in a Chinese examination and an English examination:

The teacher adjusts the score of the English Examination of each student by using the following formula: \(Y=aX+b\), where Y is the adjusted score, X is the original score and a, b are constants. It is known that the mean and the standard deviation of the adjusted score of the English Examination is equal to that of the Chinese Examination.

(a) Find a and b.

(b) Two of the above students have left the group. Their adjusted scores of the English Examination are 48 and 72 respectively. Briefly describe the change in the mean and the standard deviation of the adjusted score of the English Examination after their leaving. Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
下表顯示一大組學生在中文及英文考試的分數平均數及標準差：

老師按公式調整每名學生的英文分數，其中 Y 為調整後分數，X 為原分數，a、b 為常數。已知調整後英文分數的平均數及標準差與中文考試相同。

(a) 求 a 及 b。

(b) 上述兩名學生離開該組，其調整後英文分數分別為 48 及 72。簡述他們離開後，調整後英文分數的平均數及標準差有何改變。解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) (a,b)=(1.5,−15) or (−1.5,135). (b) Both unchanged: mean 60, σ=12.
questions.solutionZh: (a) (a,b)=(1.5,−15) 或 (−1.5,135)；(b) 平均數及標準差均不變，仍分別為 60 及 12。退出兩人的平均分為 60，兩項離均差平方亦均為 144。
